name: @shieldfont/react
description: ShieldFont React component. Encodes in Node, so your original text never ships in plain form. Screen readers get the real text: every protected block carries a visible notice with a button that shows it, on by default, tested with NVDA and VoiceOver. A v0 alpha. Accessibility law differs by country and applies to you as the site operator, so check yours first.
author: Isaque Seneda and Gabriel Abrucio
